# stapel-react — llms.txt index

12/20 packages describe their own surface in llms.txt as of this build.

Generated by `scripts/gen-root-llms.mjs` from each package's package.json (`description`) and llms.txt presence. Do not edit by hand.

An agent that does not yet know which package it needs reads this ONE file, then follows the link for that package's full surface (exports, hooks, operations, errors).

## Described (12)

- **@stapel/auth-react** — packages/auth-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-auth: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines (OTP, password, OAuth, TOTP, sessions, passkeys, QR, magic links, SSO), and the step-up verification factor flow. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/billing-react** — packages/billing-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-billing: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/calendar-react** — packages/calendar-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-calendar: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/core** — packages/core/llms.txt — Stapel frontend runtime (L0): typed fetch with the Stapel error envelope, auth token/refresh seams, verification-403 interception, TanStack Query layer with per-user persistence, i18n engine, config provider, breakpoints hook.
- **@stapel/docs-react** — packages/docs-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-docs: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, snapshot-save discipline (If-Match head_seq), the editor_hint registry (registerDocEditor), headless components (documents / folder tree / editor / revisions / trash / upload / media), and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the self-themed antd skin (file manager, context menus, revision modal, editors) — every part swappable via the skin slot registry.
- **@stapel/forms-react** — packages/forms-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-forms: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, LoadState-disciplined headless bags (fill / builder / responses / list), a per-kind field-widget registry over the stapel-attributes vocabulary, client-side validation that mirrors the server's own error keys, the captcha_token seam and the X-Forms-Next-Before CSV export cursor. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the self-themed antd skin (StapelForm, FormBuilderPane, ResponsesPane, FormsListPane) — every field widget and skin slot swappable without a fork.
- **@stapel/notifications-react** — packages/notifications-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-notifications: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/profiles-react** — packages/profiles-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-profiles: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/recordings-react** — packages/recordings-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-recordings: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, headless components (list / compose / upload-finalize), and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
- **@stapel/search-react** — packages/search-react/llms.txt — Headless React pair for stapel-search: a typed query client, TanStack Query hooks, and a URL-first state codec that makes a search shareable by construction (filters, ranges, geo, sort and the keyset cursor all live in the query string). Drill-down facets rendered with their remaining counts and with the server's own honesty flags — approximate, skipped, degraded — never swallowed; keyset pagination with the window refusal named; DSA Art. 26 `promoted` marking carried into every card slot and the P2B Art. 5 ranking disclosure exposed as data. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin, and /router binds the codec to react-router's useSearchParams.
- **@stapel/tokens** — packages/tokens/llms.txt — Stapel design tokens (§68 neutral colour-role dictionary): a single JSON source of truth compiled to a version-independent CSS custom-property core plus addressable adapters (Tailwind v4 default, v3 legacy), typed names, typography, spacing, radii, elevation, and the three breakpoints. Ships its OWN generator as the `stapel-tokens` bin — no host vendors/forks it. Not components.
- **@stapel/workspaces-react** — packages/workspaces-react/llms.txt — Headless React flow pair for stapel-workspaces: typed API client, TanStack Query hooks, flow machines, headless components, and i18n keys. Zero visual opinion.
